provenance_note: Reference CSVs were downloaded from a third-party mirror because the official download redirected to Microsoft sign-in. Check matches_inspected_mirror for these actual inputs. Equality with the inaccessible official files remains unverified.
selection_rule: Highest validation average precision; exact tie favors Random Forest; no refit

split.method: First StratifiedGroupKFold split, five folds, shuffle=True
split.grouping: pandas feature hash, excluding row index and targets

curves.note: Curves show at most 200 sampled points; reported metrics use all validation scores.
